The Department of Humanities and Sciences serves as a vital support unit, enriching academic programs across IST. In today’s interdisciplinary and industry-driven landscape, the importance of soft skills alongside technical knowledge has become increasingly clear. Scientific expertise alone is no longer sufficient; career success also depends on emotional intelligence, teamwork, adaptability, and a strong ethical foundation.
Our department is committed to cultivating these essential attributes by fostering critical thinking, ethical awareness, language proficiency, and professional communication. With a dedicated and experienced faculty, we inculcate leadership skills and real-world preparedness in our students through practical engagement and scenario-based learning. These competencies not only enhance employability but also prepare students to become forward-thinking professionals and responsible citizens, ready to contribute meaningfully to society.

=== DEPARTMENT: Hod'S Message ===
=== SECTION: Hod'S Message ===
SOURCE_URL: https://ist.edu.pk/academics?page=239&section=hod's-message
SCRAPED_AT: 2026-05-18T11:42:56Z

The quest for the unknown is a human instinct, be it space exploration, energy harvesting, human body support, or fighting microorganisms. At every front, we need materials with special properties. We require strong materials that can withstand high temperatures to travel in space. We require functional materials to harvest energy. We require materials with biocompatibility and bioactivity to support weakened parts of our body. Modern transport systems cannot function without rare earth metals. The air transport industry is looking for self-healing materials. The present and the future belong to those who understand materials and we are those people known as Materials Engineers.The Department of Materials Science & Engineering (MS&E) at the Institute of Space Technology is a state-of-the-art department and materials dedicated labs with highly skilled and experienced faculty, engineers, and staff. Our BS program is focused on Nanotechnology, Functional Materials, Energy Materials, Composites, Polymers, Aerospace Materials, Minerals Utilization, and Failure Analysis of Materials. We equip our students with the tools of computation materials and Artificial Intelligence. We have lab facilities including SEM, XRD, FTIR, BET, AFM, Gamry Instruments, and Tribometer. Our students work with 3D printing as well as bulk and nano-coatings. We teach our graduates according to global requirements and recent research trends. Our engineering program is accredited by the Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) and is fully linked with the Outcome-based Education (OBE) System as per the Washington Accord.Our senior students have a track record of support to junior students and we arrange regular gettogethers, welcome/farewell parties. The students are encouraged to take Final Year Projects (FYPs) proposed by industry or work in specialized areas using the available state-of-the-art research facilities. The American Chemical Society (ACS) chapter of our Department received an outstanding achievement award in 2025.We have very strong MS and PhD programs as well. Our alumni are working in national and multinational companies, some are pursuing higher studies and many students have their businesses as well. We have strong interaction and scholarship opportunities for study in countries like China, South Korea, Germany, the UK, UAE, and Saudi Arabia. We believe that the MS&E Department at IST is the best place to train the new generation in the Materials Engineering field. The capacity enhancement of our Department is linked with CPEC and mineral extraction and we expect that it will further boost the job opportunities of Materials Engineers who are well-versed in the advanced Materials Engineering field.
Dr. Sajid Ullah KhanHead of DepartmentMaterials Science and Engineering

=== DEPARTMENT: About ===
=== SECTION: About ===
SOURCE_URL: https://ist.edu.pk/academics?page=396&section=about
SCRAPED_AT: 2026-05-18T11:42:56Z

The Department of Mechanical Engineering provides a firm foundation in basic sciences, mathematics and design methodology in the area of mechanical structures, fluids, manufacturing and thermal systems. Engines, ships, train, air & space vehicles, steam & gas turbine, machine tools, robots etc are a few systems and devices that need the knowledge of mechanical engineering. The curriculum includes the methodological tools, innovative thought, communication skills, management tools, and provide students the opportunities to work efficiently as individuals and in teams. In the senior year of the program, students are required to apply the theoretical knowledge to real world problems and gain hands-on engineering experiences that require problem designing, team work, communication, time management and economic analysis. The department encourages students to pursue internships that link academic knowledge to lifelong work experiences. The department also offers the opportunity for the students to participate in professional societies such as the American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), Institution of Mechanical Engineers (IMechE) and American Institute of Aeronautics & Astronautics (AIAA) etc.
The reason for offering mechanical engineering is to prepare students for a wide range of exciting industrial opportunities including aerospace, manufacturing, automotive, chemical, biomedical, nuclear power, robotics, and textiles. Mechanical Engineers can find employment in the field of research & development, production & manufacturing, design, operation & maintenance, and administration.

SCRAPED_AT: 2026-05-18T11:42:56Z

“The Department of Applied Mathematics and Statistics (AM&S) at the Institute of Space Technology (IST), Islamabad, stands as one of the most dynamic and productive departments of the university, particularly renowned for its graduate programs (MS and PhD). Our department offers highly sought-after interdisciplinary specializations, including Computational Fluid Dynamics and Fluid Mechanics, Computational Mathematics, Nonlinear Dynamics, Cryptography, Group Theory and Generalizations, Algebra and Algebraic Geometry, and Applied Statistics. Our undergraduate program in BS Mathematics is structured into three specialized tracks: BS Mathematics, Mathematics with Data Science and BS Mathematics with Artificial Intelligence. These technology-driven streams enhance the relevance and marketability of our graduates and prepare them to thrive in a rapidly evolving global environment.
Since its establishment in 2014, AM&S has focused on equipping students with strong computational, analytical and problem-solving skills. The department takes pride in its dedicated and research-active faculty, committed to high-quality education, impactful research and global academic standards. Our interdisciplinary curriculum not only strengthens the foundation of science and engineering students but also empowers them to conduct impactful research that addresses real-world challenges. Through industry collaborations, innovative teaching practices and strong research linkages with leading international institutions, AM&S plays a vital role in advancing knowledge and contributing to the socio-economic development of Pakistan. It is a matter of pride that many of our MS and PhD graduates have secured prestigious doctoral and postdoctoral positions in highly ranked global institutions.
With a vibrant learning ecosystem, state-of-the-art research facilities and a forward-looking approach, we welcome aspiring students to join us in advancing the frontiers of mathematics and contributing to innovative solutions for the challenges of tomorrow. ”
Professor Dr. Maryiam JavedHead of DepartmentFacebookFacebookTwitterTwitter

=== DEPARTMENT: Space Science ===
=== SECTION: Space Science ===
SOURCE_URL: https://ist.edu.pk/academics?section=space-science
SCRAPED_AT: 2026-05-18T11:42:56Z

Space Science is the study and research of issues specifically related to space flight/ travel and space exploration. It comprises of interdisciplinary fields e.g. Stellar, Solar, Galactic and Extragalactic Astronomy, Planetary Science and Physical Cosmology, Astrobiology, Astrochemistry, Astrophysics, Space Plasma Physics, Orbital Mechanics/ Astrodynamics, Atmospheric/ Environmental Science, Satellite and Space Communications, Space Systems, Space Environment and Space Medicine.
Rapidly growing subjects of Space Science in the present era of information technology are in process of evolution from the state of infancy to the advanced levels at academic and research institutions. The significant subjects falling under the umbrella of Space Science comprise Remote Sensing, Satellite Applications, Space Physics, Astrodynamics, Atmospheric Science etc. The courses offered in the department are the main building blocks of Space Science. Emphasis has also been given to research and applications-oriented areas such as Flight Dynamics and Control, Space Mission Design and Analysis, Space Data Processing and Geoinformatics. The Space Science uses new space-age technologies like satellite positioning, space data visualizations, analysis tools and space data interpretation to greatly advance scientific understanding of Earth and its systems. With the launch of Earth resources satellites in Low Earth Orbit and Communication Satellites in Geostationary and various other orbits around the Earth, space based observatory mission, deep space probes and robots for planetary explorations; the last decade has witnessed a wide spectrum of applications in diverse fields subject to the need and quality of imagery datasets acquired from the Earth orbiting satellites. The advances in computing technology & techniques have also contributed a lot in the development of more sophisticated than ever sensors capable of observing the Earth with specialized and dedicated on-board sensors with the help of satellite constellations.
The Space Science department at IST is a truly multidisciplinary department. As society looks towards the future, we continue the pursuit of further understanding the Earth system and beyond with our focus on, Remote Sensing and Geographical Information Science, Astronomy and Astrophysics, Physics, Astrodynamics, Atmospheric and Environmental Science, Meteorology and Earth Sciences. The department also conducts public awareness programs like Sky-watch/ Star-gazing shows and World Space Week (UN) for scientific outreach.

=== DEPARTMENT: Social Media ===
=== SECTION: About ===
SOURCE_URL: https://ist.edu.pk/academics?page=260&section=about
SCRAPED_AT: 2026-05-18T11:42:56Z

Avionics is one of the key components of Aeronautics and Astronautics that focuses on electrical, electronics and computing aspects of aircraft and spacecraft. Avionics and Aerospace Systems blend together to make the amazing aerial and space vehicles of the modern era a reality. However, the avionics systems not only constitute the on-board electronics systems but a number of ground based systems that help in Air Traffic Management, namely, communication, navigation and surveillance systems. Avionics systems are primarily complex cyber physical systems that comply with ultra-high reliability criteria to meet design requirements of safety critical aviation and space borne systems. Even autonomous surface and marine vehicles use design processes developed for avionics systems. As such, avionics is a broad based applied field and avionics engineers acquire practical knowledge of multiple domains of electrical, computing and aerospace disciplines.
In the Department of Avionics Engineering we are committed to imparting practical knowledge and skills to our students, which makes them a very sought after candidates for a wide range of engineering outfits, both military and commercial. We have state of the art labs equipped with most relevant systems. We boast a faculty that is not only academically highly qualified but also carries vast and varied experience of working in prime aviation and space related organizations. Our hallmark is the personal interaction we maintain with all our students. Owing to their versatile knowledge base, the employment percentage of our graduates is higher than other disciplines .

=== DEPARTMENT: Engr. Masood Khalid Director Incharge KICSIT ===
=== SECTION: About ===
SOURCE_URL: https://ist.edu.pk/academics?parent=214&section=about
SCRAPED_AT: 2026-05-18T11:42:56Z

Director's Message
Engr. Masood Khalid Director Incharge KICSIT
Its my pleasure to welcome you at Dr. A. Q Khan Institute of Computer Sciences and Information Technology (KICSIT), Kahuta, a campus of Institute of Space Technology (IST), Islamabad. It has the privilege that it was inaugurated in November 2000 by Dr. Abdul Qadeer Khan himself, the founder and then Chairman of KRL.
KICSIT aims to offer quality education at an affordable cost. Currently, it is offering two four-year degree programs as Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering (BSCE) and Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (BSCS). BSCE is accredited by PEC (Pakistan Engineering Council) and BSCS is accredited by NCEAC (National Computing Education Accreditation Council).
KICSIT is ideally located in an exclusively peaceful and secure environment. The Institute does have an elite faculty with foreign-qualified PhDs and MS degree-holders having decades of practical industrial experience, KICSIT is housed in its own purposefully-built air-conditioned campus.
In view of its increasing students strength and scope, the New Campus of KICSIT has been developed next to the lush green and scenic hills of Kahuta. This is on main Rawalpindi-Kahuta Road and covers an area of above 100 Kanals.
Though KICSIT is a small-size institute, yet by grace of Almighty it has a shining record in terms of students and alumni. A large number of alumni have joined Strategic Organizations, Armed Forces and Multinational Companies. In higher education, many studied and got degrees from US, UK and other Foreign Universities. Also, KICSIT students have been competing well in the inter-university competitions and have won many awards in sofrware, hardware and extra carrucullar areas, showing a nice grooming level prevalent here.
Thus, overall it is expected that our students find their stay at KICSIT a memorable and fruitful time period of their lives.
For detailed academic and administrative information, please visit the official KICSIT website.

## KICSIT DIRECTOR & MERIT SCHOLARSHIPS (VOICE FAQ)
======================================================================

=== KICSIT / DIRECTOR (NOT KARACHI CITY) ===
Q: Who is the director of KICSIT? Engr. Masood Khalid is Director Incharge of KICSIT (Dr. A. Q. Khan Institute of Computer Sciences and Information Technology). KICSIT is an IST campus at Kahuta — Sumbal Gah Kahuta, District Rawalpindi — it is not located in Karachi city.
Q: Karachi campus KICSIT director? Many people say Karachi but KICSIT is the Kahuta campus of IST. Director Incharge: Engr. Masood Khalid. Contact 051-9285059, 051-9285187, info@kicsit.edu.pk.
Q: IST Karachi director? For RS and GIS programs IST historically used National Centre facilities linked to Karachi; KICSIT computer campus is at Kahuta with Director Incharge Engr. Masood Khalid.

=== MERIT SCHOLARSHIP — RANK VS MINIMUM GPA ===
Q: Merit scholarship GPA rule BS? IST awards up to three merit scholarships per undergraduate discipline per policy; 1st 2nd 3rd positions get fee waivers; minimum SGPA is stated in the policy table (often above 3.50 for continuing semesters). Scholarships are competitive: you must meet the minimum SGPA AND rank among the top position-holders in your discipline — meeting the minimum alone does not guarantee an award.
Q: Merit scholarship GPA rule MS? IST awards up to two merit scholarships per MS discipline per published policy. Policy states minimum SGPA and CGPA thresholds for each tier; if your GPA is higher than the published minimum, you meet that eligibility requirement; actual awards still go to the top-ranked eligible students each semester, not automatically to everyone above the floor.
Q: If my GPA is 4.0 and minimum is 3.75 do I get MS merit scholarship? A 4.0 GPA satisfies a minimum stated as above 3.75; merit scholarships are limited to top 1st and 2nd position-holders per MS discipline per policy, so explain eligibility plus rank-based selection — do not say the student is ineligible solely because of a wrong comparison.
